dependencies.rule: Information requirements, MIDP/TIDP, and permitted-use constraints drive platform configuration, release cadence, and metadata.
Semantic schemas, naming, and classification feed container metadata and validation attributes.
WIP/Shared folders, ACC Issues, Model Coordination, and Reviews provide infrastructure for coordination and Gate E sign-off.
Published containers stage formal submissions; Transmittals record exchange; Records and Archive stores immutable handover records.

resolved_by_curator.resolution: Internal ACC system-of-record authority is distinct from contract-designated external CDE contractual/legal authority.
Project Administrator is platform capability; Information Manager, Project BIM Manager, and CDE Manager remain distinct governed roles.
